name: reentrancy-protected
description: Bank contract using CEI pattern + nonReentrant guard — reentrancy is not possible
why_safe: Two independent protections both prevent reentrancy: (1) state (balances) is decremented BEFORE the external ETH call (CEI), so re-entry sees balance = 0. (2) nonReentrant modifier prevents any re-entry at the function level. Either one alone is sufficient.

expected_verdict.reason: CEI pattern applied correctly (balance decremented before call) AND nonReentrant guard active. Double protection. Negative memory pattern FP-SEED-002 applies.
